en.html:
Since ancient times, this was the state a warrior was supposed to aim for. Ask what exactly it meant and each person could supply a different explanation. On the actual work, however, agreement existed: cut the delay between the pilot giving an order and the tsurugi responding.

To zero, if possible. Not even a little gap in which to suffer.

Nobody had ever reached that peak, so it was said. But the enemy machine was standing very close to the top. That much I knew.

en.html:
Just that much should change something.

Not sharing out the guilt and responsibility. Ulta. Accepting that these were the things we could not share, could not hand over, however convenient the arrangement might be.

I would fight by my own will, take my own responsibility, bear my own guilt. Muramasa too would fight by her own will and responsibility.

The other's will was not land to occupy. Leave it alone. Respect it.

This much sense we should have found earlier, while we were wasting all that effort trying to bend the other one double.

ja.html:
それだけで、何かは変わる筈だった。

　罪と責任を分かち合うのではなく。
　むしろその逆――分かち合えない、譲れないという
事を、相互に認め合う。

　俺は俺の意思と責任において戦い、罪を負う。
　村正も村正の意思と責任において戦う。

　互いの意思を侵さず、尊重する。

　より早く、そうしているべきだったのだ。
　互いに相手をねじ伏せようと不毛な努力を重ねる間
に。

Muramasa《...What meaning is there in this?》
Kageaki"Meaning is there, I think. Probably we need it."
Kageaki"For you and me to fight together."
Muramasa《A-all this time we have been fighting together only, no?》
Kageaki"No. Side by side we have been fighting. Together is a different matter."
Kageaki"I did not acknowledge you; you did not acknowledge me. That problem we kept conveniently unclear. Put on the armor, fool ourselves a little more, somehow manage."
Kageaki"The enemy was the same, so somehow between us we made the appearance of one warrior... But defeating Silver Star, that we still cannot do."
Muramasa《............》
Kageaki"We must win."
Kageaki"For that victory, Muramasa. Whatever you think of me, think it. Hands and feet only, if that is what you insist I am, fine... But those hands and feet also have a will they cannot give up. That much you must acknowledge."
Kageaki"Please."

en.html:
Again I asked.

For a while, the metal-echo sent back only silence, sounding bewildered even in its silence.

Too late, too convenient a request, was it? Two years I had barely considered the tsurugi I was supposed to rely on as my other half. Now the wasted years were hurting. Now, after spending them so freely.

en.html: Balance of Good and Evil. It looked like a curse. In truth, the law had been a sincere wish for peace. It took my adoptive mother's life—think of that, and resentment came readily enough. But again, I was sending it to the wrong address. Who had sensed that Muramasa carried something terrible, then released her without thinking deeply? I had. Nobody else had done that part on my behalf. As for the belief that, at the very root, neither good nor evil existed in this world—◆no, I could not agree completely. Some part of me would not go that far. Still, I could understand. In that mire of war between the Northern and Southern Courts, perhaps they could see no hope of ending the conflict except by confronting it with this ultimate conclusion. Now I had seen those scenes. Four written characters, Balance of Good and Evil; how much of their hope had been put inside them, I could understand. And the grief at the terrible end that hope had brought.
en.text:
Balance of Good and Evil.

It looked like a curse. In truth, the law had been a sincere wish for peace.

It took my adoptive mother's life—think of that, and resentment came readily enough. But again, I was sending it to the wrong address. Who had sensed that Muramasa carried something terrible, then released her without thinking deeply? I had. Nobody else had done that part on my behalf.

As for the belief that, at the very root, neither good nor evil existed in this world—◆no, I could not agree completely.

Some part of me would not go that far.

Still, I could understand. In that mire of war between the Northern and Southern Courts, perhaps they could see no hope of ending the conflict except by confronting it with this ultimate conclusion.

Now I had seen those scenes. Four written characters, Balance of Good and Evil; how much of their hope had been put inside them, I could understand.

And the grief at the terrible end that hope had brought.

ja.html: 善悪相殺。 　呪いと見えてその実、和平への真摯な願いであった 戒律。 　それが養母の命を奪ったと思えば恨みも湧く。 　が、やはり筋違いの怨恨であった。村正が恐ろしい 何かを背負っていると感付きつつ、深く思慮せず解き 放ってしまったのは、誰でもない俺なのだから。 　そうして、この世には突き詰めて善も悪もないのだ という信念について思いを致せば――◆必ずしも完全な 同意はできない。 　そこまで思い切れない部分がある。 　しかし理解は及んだ。 　南北朝というまさしく泥沼の抗争期においてはその 究極論をもって挑むほかに、戦乱を治める希望が全く 見出せなかったのだろう。 　あの情景を見た今ならば、善悪相殺の四文字に託さ れた想いの深さが知れる。 　その想いが招いた、凄惨な末路への無念も。
ja.text:
善悪相殺。
　呪いと見えてその実、和平への真摯な願いであった
戒律。

　それが養母の命を奪ったと思えば恨みも湧く。
　が、やはり筋違いの怨恨であった。村正が恐ろしい
何かを背負っていると感付きつつ、深く思慮せず解き
放ってしまったのは、誰でもない俺なのだから。

　そうして、この世には突き詰めて善も悪もないのだ
という信念について思いを致せば――◆必ずしも完全な
同意はできない。

　そこまで思い切れない部分がある。

　しかし理解は及んだ。
　南北朝というまさしく泥沼の抗争期においてはその
究極論をもって挑むほかに、戦乱を治める希望が全く
見出せなかったのだろう。

　あの情景を見た今ならば、善悪相殺の四文字に託さ
れた想いの深さが知れる。

　その想いが招いた、凄惨な末路への無念も。

Leave all the reasoning aside. This was my conclusion: right now, I must not remain separated from Muramasa. Whatever else, I had to go after her!

If I did not, for the rest of my life I would regret it. That much I felt certain of.

But...
How to go?

A detained prisoner was not a free man just because he had reached an urgent conclusion. Contact the Chief, have him arrange my release—that too would take time.

Several hours, at the very least.
............Would I still be in time!?
en.text:
Leave all the reasoning aside. This was my conclusion: right now, I must not remain separated from Muramasa. Whatever else, I had to go after her!

If I did not, for the rest of my life I would regret it. That much I felt certain of.

But...
How to go?

A detained prisoner was not a free man just because he had reached an urgent conclusion. Contact the Chief, have him arrange my release—that too would take time.

Several hours, at the very least.
............Would I still be in time!?

ja.html:
全ての理屈を抜きにして、俺はそう結論した。
　今、村正と離れたままでいてはいけない。<ruby>とにかく<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>
追わなくてはならない！

　追わねば、俺はきっと生涯悔いる。

　だが……
　どうしたものか。

　拘置囚の身に自由はない。
　署長に連絡し、釈放の手続きを踏んで貰うにも時間
が掛かる。

　最短でも数時間必要だ。
　…………間に合うか!?
